cautions: foreground_context_columns_present appears in leakage audits for all tiers; no forbidden labels or near-perfect univariate columns were detected, but this is a scientific caution.
context_only_shortcut_high warning remains from prior ablation context; final claims should emphasize conservative_branch_site and controls.
100K on 36 GB unified memory may take multiple days and requires streamed/capped outputs.
conditions: Keep conservative_branch_site as production feature policy.
Keep methods identity, mafft, babappalign, muscle only; PRANK/T-Coffee diagnostic only.
Keep BABAPPAlign embedded MPS worker cap at 4 on 36 GB unified memory unless benchmarked otherwise.
Run 100K tier-by-tier, never monolithically; keep stage markers and memory guard.
Do not interpret as empirical branch-site inference; this is simulation-supervised research-alpha evidence.
Preserve and review context-only shortcut warning and foreground-context leakage warning when writing scientific claims.
rationale: All four 10K tiers completed with explicit simulator branch-site truth and no partial markers.
All four aligner methods completed 10,000/10,000 family-method alignments per tier with zero failures and no quarantines.
Conservative branch-site neural test AUROC remains high across tiers, including extreme tier AUROC 0.9894218214694062.
Branch-level and branch-to-gene aggregation remain near-perfect; destructive controls degrade as expected.
Disk free space is currently about 1.4 TiB, enough for a 100K run if outputs remain streamed/capped, but 100K may use hundreds of GB.
